The adversarial closure rebaseline requires current two-source erase geometry, closes legacy authority, shares exact serial-exchange validation, and audits causal autonomous evidence.

Version 24 adds generic local-first heavy dependency guidance plus health-bound, process-safe Zephyr workspace, SDK, Python, and canonical build-output reuse.

Version 28 contains raw and symbol memory reads to their exact backend-access spans, allowing mapped regions while denying UNKNOWN and PROHIBITED before target I/O.
Version 29 adds symmetric scoped bootloader refresh, stable drift classifications and remedies, honest unsupported-board safety setup, and removes unconsumable safety continuation IDs.
Version 30 deliberately adds the always-visible collect_build_artifacts MCP tool, its non-authorizing canonical artifact manifest/handoff, and coherent metadata-driven Zephyr ELF/linker-map export.

Version 31 moves reviewed board and serial fallback selection into validated packaged data, removes MCU-derived address/attach/recovery defaults, makes native build plus artifact collection the generic MCP guidance, and retains Zephyr and vendor helpers only as labeled fallbacks.
Version 32 removes Python prefix/wildcard part-to-target inference; automatic setup accepts only the exact reviewed catalog mapping, while staged packs may provide but never redefine that target.
Version 34 rebaselines Safety Layer v2: one memory_map.yaml authority, refresh-only stable-map maintenance, lean validation, plan-bound artifacts, and removal of public board_safety_setup.

Version 35 removes caller-owned board_type and datasheet_sha256 from setup, resolves reviewed support internally from the exact MCU plus server-hashed datasheet, and preserves native-build-first guidance.
change_notes: Version 36 binds serial finalizers, makes UART optional, enforces one-to-one startup routing, fixes flash cancellation boundaries, and keeps build fallback local-only and MCU-neutral.
Version 37 makes incomplete same-identity repair executable and enforces run-scoped one-to-one startup assignments through setup and validation.
Version 38 closes flash-timeout completion, preserves legacy identity during repair, invalidates stale assignments, validates Cortex-M vectors, and updates the fresh-workspace runner contract.

Version 39 serializes setup revocation before assignment replacement, binds validation stamping atomically, strengthens flash vector containment, and keeps the fresh runner server-routed and fail-closed.
Version 40 adds the provider-neutral local-only native build helper, exact setup-status argv guidance, coherent NCS/sysbuild selection, and offline build guards without adding hardware authority.
Version 41 makes immutable bindings interoperable across equivalent integral JSON-number encodings for schema NUMBER fields while preserving exact types for authority-bearing JSON payloads.
Version 42 makes loaded board_validate guidance copy the current run-scoped assigned probe and fail closed when no such assignment exists.
Version 43 binds the successfully flashed application ELF to symbol tools for this server run, rechecks its digest before use, and refuses unavailable symbol metadata without backend access.
Version 44 adds local-only generic Make builds and exact reviewed STM32L476 pack-backed setup while binding pyOCD target registration to one snapshotted manifest-selected pack.
Version 45 lets fresh reviewed pack-backed boards use the server and active-project pinned manifests during exact target preflight without inference or downloads.
Version 46 preserves reviewed pre-commit connect mode, clock, and identity policy through the shared backend without forcing a reference-board probe.
Version 47 preserves immutable selected-probe identity before any J-Link UID-normalization retry opens a backend session.
Version 48 lets validation recognize non-built-in targets only through a verified manifest-selected pack while keeping built-in targets independent of pack registration.
Version 49 requires fresh setup preflight to bind a verified pack's filename, digest, target, and board scope to the reviewed catalog before hardware connection.
Version 50 adds server-registry-only exact CMSIS-Pack support binding and a closed generic device-support profile source record without changing any public tool schema.
Version 51 adds schema-v3 generic physical maps, registry-replayed support during setup and refresh, and makes absent erase/deployment evidence explicitly read/debug-only.

Version 53 adds quarantined exact-part CMSIS-Pack onboarding, project-scoped pack and datasheet replay, schema-v3 generic physical maps, compatible identity gating, adaptive attach facts, and one-way blank-device application allocation without changing public tool schemas.

Version 54 binds quarantined live attach and target enumeration to bounded exact pack bytes, keeps unpromoted packs out of the global cache, requires exact live identity for flash, and persists generic allocation ownership before backend mutation.

Version 55 keeps discovery agent-led while validating exact pack/PDSC/target bytes, maps pack RAM/ROM/flash and SVD peripherals, permits compatible-identity application programming, and replaces blank-only first flash with server-derived monotonic artifact allocation.
Version 56 lets a project route only the requested boards among multiple visible probes while preserving explicit, run-scoped one-to-one assignments for every selected board.
Version 57 makes successful deterministic safety refresh associate the profile with its canonical map so first-map recovery becomes reusable setup state.
